messages:
infra-bot: INCIDENT ALERT  — routing anomalies detected across us-east/us-west/eu
infra-bot: metric: global.error_rate spike > 4x for /generate endpoints
infra-bot: fallback activity ramping: requests moved us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east in ~30s loops
ryan (oncall): on it. paging now. @alice @carla please join - I'm on default pager
alice (sre): joining. seeing repeated healthcheck flaps in router logs: `hc_status=UNHEALTHY` toggling between regions every 10s
carla (ml-infra): fwiw, telemetry shows a model-variant mismatch on fallback: requests landing in eu are served by `llama-13b-quant-v2` while caller expected `llama-13b-8bit`. Some clients see deserialization errors
ben (platform): can we pause smart-routing so requests stick to origin region? what's the admin API call
ryan (oncall): issuing temporary policy lock: 
```
POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/routing/policy/lock
{"policy":"smart-fallback","reason":"incident-2398765432","ttl_s":1800}
```
deploy-bot: policy lock accepted (txn id: lock-8a7f)
alice (sre): started patch to healthcheck debounce from 3/20s -> 6/60s. applying now
ben (platform): confirmed sticky routing enabled via admin API: `stickiness=region_prefer` on host groups
carla (ml-infra): investigating variant mapping: looks like a recent config change in model-registry mapping for `eu` default fallback -> `llama-13b-quant-v2` (incompatible). reverting to `llama-13b-8bit` now
support-ops: getting customer reports: several enterprise customers in eu saw 502s between 07:13 and 07:35 UTC, filing sev2 notifications
ryan (oncall): timeline: alert at 07:12 UTC, mitigation (policy lock + debounce) at 07:15 UTC, variant revert at 07:22 UTC
alice (sre): metrics: error_rate /generate peaked at 07:14 UTC, 5xx rate down to baseline by 07:34 UTC
carla (ml-infra): revert applied, gating to 10% rollout for 3m, then 100% at 07:22:30
deploy-bot: config-change: model-registry mapping updated (change-id: mr-2026-2398)
ryan (oncall): running post-checks: `curl -sS https://metrics/internal?series=error_rate|/generate` -> looks clean
alice (sre): check router logs for absence of rapid hc toggles: `kubectl logs router-*-pod -n infra | grep hc_status` -> stable
support-ops: informed affected customers via status page update. estimated impacted requests ~2% global, concentrated eu, duration ~22m
ben (platform): root cause hypothesis: simultaneous policy rollouts — a model-registry config change + lower healthcheck debounce + new smart-fallback priority allowed hopscotch fallbacks that exposed incompatible variant mapping
carla (ml-infra): action items: (1) block automatic variant mapping rollouts for fallback paths, (2) add validation to ensure fallback variant ABI compatibility, (3) add unit test for model-registry -> routing mapping
alice (sre): ops items: (1) increase default deque debounce to 10/90s, (2) add circuit breaker on cross-region fallback count > 3 in 1m, (3) better observability for per-request variant id
ryan (oncall): I'm closing the active page. I'll open a follow-up incident doc with timeline and incident commander handoff
support-ops: will post customer-impact summary and update status.incidents.redwood.com
infra-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — auto-checks pass
ryan (oncall): thanks everyone. reopen if regressions appear :thumbsup:
